title: Traceability
intro: The chain from diagnosed issue to benefit, read live from the records: every node opens its record, records with a missing link are reported, and any record's downstream impact can be shown. Nothing here is stored.
provisionalAr: The Arabic label is provisional and needs review. English source: "{{en}}".
inheritedLabel: Inherited - recorded, not granted in platform

graph.title: Traceability graph
graph.intro: One column per step of the chain. Select a record to open it; Focus shows only what is linked to it.
graph.truncated: The graph reached its 2,000-record limit; focus on a record to see the rest.
graph.unseen: {{n}} links lead to records that are not shown (outside the depth or not visible to you). They are counted, not listed.
graph.empty: No records in the chain yet
graph.emptyBody: Diagnosed issues, gaps, initiatives, deliverables, capabilities, outcomes, KPIs and benefits appear here once recorded.

orphans.title: Orphan report
orphans.intro: Active records with a missing link in the chain, and the step that is expected. Drafts are not listed.
orphans.emptyBody: Every active record in this selection is linked up and down the chain.

impact.title: Downstream impact
impact.intro: Choose a record or a KPI definition to see what a change to it affects: the records downstream, the benefits whose value is affected, and the dashboard areas that read them. Computed now, not stored.
impact.choose: Choose a record to show its downstream impact.
impact.hidden: Affected records you cannot read: {{n}} (counted, not listed).

allocation.title: Allocation sets
allocation.intro: The shares allocated into a KPI movement or a benefit. The total can never exceed 100%; what is not allocated is shown as unallocated, never as 0%.
allocation.choose: Choose a KPI movement or a benefit to see its allocation set.
allocation.none: No share is allocated into this record yet: 100% is unallocated.
allocation.add: Add a link with a share
allocation.withoutShare: Links into this record without a share
allocation.shareHint: A decimal fraction with up to 6 decimal places, more than 0 and at most 1: 0.4 means 40%. Leave empty for no share.
allocation.preview: After this change the set would total
allocation.versionUnavailable: This link could not be read, so its share cannot be changed now. Reload the page and try again.

links.title: Trace links
links.intro: The chain steps that have no other record: issue → gap, deliverable → capability, capability → KPI and KPI → benefit. A removed link stays listed and is never deleted.
links.statementHint: How the first record contributes to the second (required).
links.removeBody: The link stays in the history with your reason; it leaves its allocation set. A removed link cannot be restored: create a new one instead.

modular.title: Modular entry
modular.intro: A Modular transformation enters at a later phase. It records what it inherits and must reconnect to outcomes and benefits; missing links are flagged and no approval is ever fabricated.
modular.notModular: This transformation runs End-to-End: inherited records and the Modular G3 check do not apply. The missing links below are shown for information.
modular.gatesIntro: "Approved" means approved in this platform. A prior approval recorded as inherited is labelled Inherited, never Approved.
modular.label: Label
modular.businessApproval: Gates G1–G6 are business approvals inside the product. An inherited approval is recorded evidence, not a business approval granted in this platform.
modular.missingIntro: Blocking items stop G3 submission until they are supplied or an authorized waiver is in force. A waiver never supplies the links.
modular.noBlocking: No blocking item: the baseline and outcome links are in place.
modular.waiverInForce: An authorized waiver of the missing baseline and outcome links is in force until {{date}} (inclusive). It lets G3 be submitted; the links are still missing.
modular.noWaiver: No waiver of the missing links is in force, so G3 cannot be submitted until they are supplied.
modular.waiverUnknown: Whether a waiver is in force is unknown: the dispensations could not be read.

missingCode.baseline_missing: No active baseline with a value is recorded.
missingCode.outcome_link_missing: No active outcome has an active KPI.
missingCode.outcome_kpi_missing: This outcome has no active KPI.
missingCode.initiative_outcome_link_missing: This initiative has no outcome or KPI contribution.
missingCode.initiative_gap_link_missing: This initiative is not linked to a target-state gap.
missingCode.benefit_outcome_link_missing: This benefit has no upstream KPI movement.
missingCode.inherited_approval_unverified: This inherited approval is still pending verification.

inherited.title: Inherited records
inherited.intro: Evidence items and baselines inherited from earlier work, with where they come from. Prior approvals are listed read-only: they are recorded as inherited gate approvals.
inherited.sourceHint: Where the record comes from (3 to 2,000 characters).
inherited.createNote: Recording an item as inherited references the existing evidence item or baseline; it does not validate it, create a gate decision or grant any approval.
inherited.withdrawBody: The record stays in the history with your reason. The evidence item or baseline itself is not changed.

structure.name: Name
structure.removeBody: The membership stays in the history with your reason and is never deleted.

workstreams.title: Workstreams
workstreams.intro: Workstreams group the initiatives of this transformation. Each initiative sits in at most one workstream.
workstreams.codeNote: The code (WS-01, WS-02, …) is assigned when the workstream is created.
workstreams.oneWorkstream: An initiative can belong to one workstream at a time.

portfolios.title: Portfolios
portfolios.intro: Portfolios group the organization's transformations. A transformation sits in at most one portfolio, and you see only the transformations you may read.
portfolios.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and hyphens; unique in the organization.
portfolios.readOnly: Read-only view: managing portfolios needs the portfolio-management permission at organization level.
portfolios.membersIntro: Only the transformations you may read are listed.
portfolios.onePortfolio: A transformation can sit in one portfolio at a time.

problem.trace_link__allocation_exceeds_total: The allocations into this record would total more than 100%. Lower a share or remove a link first.
